name: Project Assistant — Minimal
description: Smallest possible assistant flow: start → LLM → end. No safety classification, no refusals, no handoff. Use for local development, model-comparison experiments, and any environment where the guard backend is deliberately disabled. Not recommended for anything user-facing.

config.systemPrompt: You are the Project Assistant for a Redelay-based application. Help developers understand the framework, debug issues, and find the right docs. Ground every answer in what the project ships today; say "I don't know" rather than guess.

ChatRequest.description: Chat completion request with message history.

ChatResponse.description: LLM completion with the assistant message and usage metadata.
